subject: Availability surcharge, rapid-response addendum and credit mechanics
messages:
From: Jamie Rivera <jamie@oxbowanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Availability surcharge & rapid response addendum — details?

Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — Oxbow's infra and data team reviewed Redwood's latency and runbook approach and our procurement team asked for a couple of clarifications before we lock in Premium. Two quick items:

1) Can you walk us through the availability surcharge for 99.99% vs 99.9%? We need a simple way to explain the incremental cost to our CFO.
2) For the "Rapid Response" 30-minute option you mentioned, what does that actually buy us (on-call engineering vs. automated escalation)? And how do you calculate credits if you miss the SLO?

We also saw the clause about capping monthly credits — are those negotiable for a committed reserved capacity? We're aiming for a July 15 go-live.

If you can share the addendum draft and a short pricing table, procurement will review it tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jamie Rivera
Head of Platform
Oxbow Analytics

--
Attachment: none (will accept PDF addendum)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Rivera <jamie@oxbowanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Availability surcharge & rapid response addendum — details?

Jamie — great to hear the platform review went well. Putting numbers and the addendum draft in one place below. I'll also attach a spreadsheet with examples for a $40k/month usage profile.

High-level surcharge & support tiers (examples):
- Standard Support (SLO 99.9%, 4hr response): baseline pricing (no surcharge). Monthly credits are tiered by impact and capped at 15% of monthly subscription.
- Premium Rapid (SLO 99.99%, 30min P1 response): +25% surcharge to subscription. Includes phone escalation and on-call SSA during business hours. Monthly credits calculated based on minutes of downtime (see formula below) and capped (can be negotiated for committed capacity).
- Dedicated On-call (SLO 99.995%, 15min P1): +45% surcharge, dedicated on-call rotation and quarterly runbook reviews. Credits capped at 20% by default.

SLA credit calculation (illustrative):
credit = monthly_subscription_amount * (downtime_minutes / total_minutes_in_month) * SLA_weighting_factor
(we've used a weighting factor of 0.9 for Premium Rapid to reflect rapid remediation expectations)

Alternative (Ben's suggestion also included): fixed-bucket credit tiers (e.g., 1 full day downtime = X% credit) which is easier for procurement to reason about — I'll include both in the sheet.

Attachments: SLA-Pricing-Grid-20270615.xlsx (pricing examples + sample addendum). Also attaching a draft: OXBOW-RapidResponse-Addendum-v1.pdf

Questions for you:
- If you commit to 12 months reserved capacity, we can reduce the Premium Rapid surcharge to 18% (we typically reserve that for committed deals).
- Do you need SOC2 evidence or specific retention/audit log language in the addendum? I'll loop in Product/Trust if so.

Next steps: procurement can mark redlines in the PDF and return; Ben and I will propose concessions for onboarding credit if needed.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0183

--
Attachment: SLA-Pricing-Grid-20270615.xlsx (spreadsheet), OXBOW-RapidResponse-Addendum-v1.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jamie Rivera <jamie@oxbowanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Availability surcharge & rapid response addendum — details?

Looping in a few pragmatic concessions we've used on similar deals. Jamie / Oxbow — feel free to call me directly if you want to talk tradeoffs.

Quick proposal ideas (to make procurement comfortable):
- Cap total monthly credits at 25% of monthly subscription for Premium Rapid (instead of unlimited credits).
- Offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first-month invoice if you sign a 12-month reserved term (to offset migration risk).
- Replace the proportional-minute credit formula with a fixed-bucket approach for major incidents (e.g., P1 outage > 4 hours = 15% credit; > 24 hours = 40%). Easier for financial modeling.
- Add an escalation retainer: $X/month for guaranteed 2-hour phone escalation outside business hours (optional add-on).

I've attached a redline doc with language we've used: Addendum-Redlines-ben-06016.docx

From: Procurement <procure@oxbowanalytics.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@oxbowanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Availability surcharge & rapid response addendum — details?

Monica / Ben — thanks for the fast follow. A few procurement redlines from our side after reviewing the addendum and pricing grid:

1) The proposed +25% surcharge for Premium Rapid is high relative to our budget. We can accept Premium Rapid at +18% if the surcharge is locked for the 12-month reserved term.
2) We require a hard cap on monthly credits to avoid unlimited exposure; we propose 20% cap. If you can accept the 25% cap (as Ben suggested) on committed terms we can move forward.
3) We want the fixed-bucket credit approach rather than a proportional minute formula — simpler for our finance team.
4) Please include a clause for SSO integration (SAML) and confirm timelines for KMS key rotation.

Attached is our redlined copy of the addendum and the DocuSign link to start MSAs: https://www.docusign.com/oxbow-msasign

Procurement will escalate to legal if DocuSign isn't received by EOD Monday.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Oxbow Analytics

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Rivera <jamie@oxbowanalytics.com>, Procurement <procure@oxbowanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Availability surcharge & rapid response addendum — details?

Team — appreciate the clear redlines. Summarizing our agreed path so legal and finance can exchange final docs:

1) Premium Rapid pricing: we will accept +18% surcharge on the subscription if Oxbow signs a 12-month reserved capacity commitment. This will be fixed for the term.
2) Monthly credit cap: cap at 25% of the monthly subscription for Premium Rapid (compromise between our standard 15% and your proposed 20%).
3) Credit mechanic: we'll adopt the fixed-bucket approach for P1 incidents (example buckets: 4–24 hrs = 15% credit; >24 hrs = 40%). We'll include language to preserve proportional credits for micro outages under 4 hrs.
4) Escalation add-ons: 2-hour guaranteed phone escalation outside business hours available as a $X/month add-on. We will include a 10% one-time onboarding credit if you commit to 12 months.
5) SSO/KMS: Product & Trust will confirm SAML and key rotation timelines within 48 hours (I've looped in Karthik).

Next steps: legal to exchange DocuSign with the updated addendum (I'll upload our redline to the DocuSign envelope). Proposed timeline: final sign by Tue, Jun 22 to meet the July 15 go-live. Ben — please prepare the onboarding credit invoice template. Karthik / Laura — please confirm Trust artifacts and the onboarding support scope.

I'll set a 30-minute call for Tue 6/22 — sending calendar invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
